## grapecoldhardiness
Developing grape cold hardiness regression models for estimating the lethal temperature that causes 50% cold damage to wine grape varieties in the Okanagan and Similkameen regions of British Columbia, Canada

### LT50 Data

Accessed from AAFC SuRDC data collection shared through the British Columbia Wine Grape Council's Grape Bud Hardiness Reports: https://bcwgc.org/report/grape-bud-hardiness-report/

### Weather Data

Downloaded from PCIC's BC Station Data for the region: https://services.pacificclimate.org/met-data-portal-pcds/app?view=1.
